# UniKey engine

Source: https://github.com/fcitx/fcitx5-unikey

Pinned commit: `ed9170c35c1a6275d105e03d7f9bc4f674c1469c` (2026-09-05).

`unikey/` contains unmodified dependency-free engine/conversion sources and
their headers. Fcitx input contexts and user keymap loading are excluded.
Original SPDX copyright and license notices are preserved. Full GPL-2.0-or-later
and LGPL-2.0-or-later texts are in the top-level `LICENSES/` directory.

The bridge in `native/` is specific to termux-viet and does not require Fcitx.
